description: Withdrawal Application No. 1 — Nigeria Human Capital Development Program Phase II (WA-NGA/HCD/2023/001): Tranche 1 disbursement for education and health expenditure verification
Withdrawal Application No. 1 — Ethiopia PSNP5 (WA-ETH/PSNP5/2023/001): Tranche 1 for beneficiary transfer payments and capacity building (Ministry of Agriculture verified)

Withdrawal Application No. 1 — Zambia AgriConnect Digital Agriculture Platform (WA-ZMB/AGRI/2023/001): Phase 1 disbursement for platform development, satellite data subscription, and 500K farmer onboarding

Withdrawal Application No. 2 — Zambia AgriConnect Digital Agriculture Platform (WA-ZMB/AGRI/2024/002): Phase 2 disbursement — scale-up to 2M smallholder farmers, market linkage corridors, and agri-finance digital services

Withdrawal Application No. 1 — AgriConnect Africa Regional Programme (WA-AFR/AGRI/2024/001): Regional Tranche 1 across Zambia, Kenya, Ethiopia, Tanzania, and Nigeria (Zambia as lead implementing agency)
Withdrawal Application No. 1 — Bangladesh Climate-Resilient Coastal Infrastructure (WA-BGD/COAST/2024/001): Tranche 1 for cyclone shelters and embankment rehabilitation in Barisal and Cox's Bazar
Withdrawal Application No. 1 — Indonesia Green Cities & Sustainable Infrastructure Programme (WA-IDN/GREENCITY/2024/001): Tranche 1 for Jakarta BRT expansion and Surabaya integrated waste management
Withdrawal Application No. 1 — India National Water Security Mission (WA-IND/WATER/2024/001): Tranche 1 for dam safety, irrigation modernisation, and urban water PPP across 12 water-stressed states

Withdrawal Application No. 1 — Pakistan Energy Sector Transformation (WA-PAK/ENERGY/2024/001): Tranche 1 for power sector reform and renewable energy — PENDING disbursement conditions verification by WB Pakistan team

Withdrawal Application No. 1 — Brazil Amazon Sustainable Land Management Programme (WA-BRA/AMAZON/2024/001): Tranche 1 for PES payments and indigenous territory protection — PENDING final environmental covenant compliance certification
